{{Short description|American mathematician}}
'''Laura J. Person''' is an American mathematician specializing in [[low-dimensional topology]]. She is a distinguished teaching professor of mathematics at the [[State University of New York at Potsdam]].{{r|dist}}

==Education and career==
Person completed her Ph.D. in mathematics at the [[University of California, Santa Barbara]] in 1988. Her dissertation, ''A Piece-Wise Linear Proof That The Singular Norm Is The Thurston Norm'', concerned the [[Thurston norm]], an invariant of three-dimensional spaces; it was supervised by [[Martin Scharlemann]].{{r|mgp}} She joined the faculty at SUNY Potsdam in 1989.{{r|dist}} At Potsdam, she is also the academic coordinator for [[volleyball]].{{r|vball}}

==Book==
Person is the co-author of the textbook ''Write Your Own Proofs In Set Theory and Discrete Mathematics'' (Zinka Press, 2005).{{r|wyop}} The book's other co-author, Amy Babich, is a Texas-based mathematician, local politician, novelist, and [[recumbent bicycle]] seller.{{r|babich}}

==Recognition==
In 2008, Person won the Clarence F. Stephens Award for Distinguished College or University Teaching of the Seaway Section of the [[Mathematical Association of America]].{{r|cfs}}
She was named as a distinguished teaching professor and a member of the SUNY Distinguished Academy in 2016.{{r|dist}}
